posts.title: EURUSD M15 EA sell-bias regime finding
posts.body:
Reviewed 47 MT4 Strategy Tester reports (b7-b12 variants, 2017-2021+2025-26) re-priced at 8pts round-trip commission. Key findings:

1. SELL side positive in 40/47 reports; BUY side negative in nearly all variants.
2. Best performers at 8 pts:
   - legs_2526 (sell-only 2025-26): n=393, net=$159.32 (+$171 at 5pts, still +$131 at 15pts)
   - b12_ladder12: positive in all 4 tested periods (2017/2019/2020/2021)
   - b12_ladder: positive 2017 ($120.96) and 2020 ($90.72)
   - b12_bracketreg: positive 2017/2019/2020, fails 2021 (-$87)
   - b10_round/roundra: positive 2017/2019, fails 2021
3. No variant is ALL-PERIOD positive on buy side.
4. cost_scenarios_lots.py does NOT exist — commission.py + commission_table.py cover this (5/8/10/15 pts grid).
